title.en: Handling an appointment: confirm, reassign, complete

intro.sr: Administrator potvrđuje zakazani termin, prebacuje ga na drugog terapeuta i označava kao završen.
intro.en: An administrator confirms a booked appointment, hands it to another therapist and marks it as completed.

admin-termini-pretraga.sr: Termin tražimo po imenu ili prezimenu klijenta.
admin-termini-pretraga.en: We look the appointment up by the client's first or last name.

termin-pregled.sr: Termin koji je klijent zakazao je „na čekanju“. Dok ga ne potvrdimo, nije konačan.
termin-pregled.en: An appointment the client booked is “pending”. Until we confirm it, it is not final.

termin-potvrda.sr: {Kliknemo} „Potvrdi termin“ i potvrđujemo u prozoru. Klijent dobija obaveštenje.
termin-potvrda.en: We {click} “Potvrdi termin” and confirm in the dialog. The client is notified.

termin-preraspodela.sr: Ako treba, termin prebacujemo na drugog terapeuta. Lista nudi samo one koji su tada slobodni i rade.
termin-preraspodela.en: If needed, we hand the appointment to another therapist. The list only offers those who are free and on shift at that time.

termin-zavrsetak.sr: Kad je tretman obavljen, {kliknemo} „Označi kao završen“. Tada se obračunava provizija zaposlenog, a ako je plaćeno paketom, troši se jedna seansa.
termin-zavrsetak.en: When the treatment is done, we {click} “Označi kao završen”. That is when the employee's commission is calculated and, if paid by a package, one session is spent.
